title: Wheypoint schema and skill ergonomics: make the checkpoint runtime pleasant for agents and humans without weakening the continuity kernel.
working_context: Issue map: #609 (undocumented delta, silent unknown keys, no dry-run, no artifact-link removal, rationale dropped at creation) is the anchor. #607 (enum fields lack validators) and #612 (converter/validator duplication) share the fix. #392, #214 are feature asks that wait for the authoring surface to settle. #352 is likely moot since resolve replaced the note scan; re-verify before closing. PR #430 was closed 2026-09-05 as superseded by #589 in megamerge #614.

Binding ADRs: workflow-contract-milknado-seam-002 (agents write slim writer views; host normalizer rejects unknown keys and fills ids/digests/provenance; JSON Schema 2020-12 generated from attrs), writer-view-boundary-simplification-001 (validate and normalize are verbs of one module; strict version equality), wheypoint-continuity-kernel-001..004 (typed record is authority; canonical JSON + SHA-256; human readability is delegated to the projection, hand-editing a digest-protected record is an anti-feature).

Schema manifest S1-S8. S1: CheckpointIntent is the only agent-facing writer view; commit becomes host-internal or compaction-only (reframed from 'collapse commit into checkpoint' to honour the writer-view ADR). S2: one entries list carrying kind replaces add_decisions/add_questions/add_blockers. S3: runtime computes artifact-link digest from path and defaults revision_id. S4: artifact links become a replaceable set, not add-only (delta-contract.md currently contradicts itself here). S5: accept rationale on a proposed entry. S6: strict unknown-key rejection on every write via a strict structure call in compat.py plus an Enum hook (closes #609 ask 1, #607, converter half of #612). S7: notes body field rendered as a Markdown section. S8: tasks field for next: tasks (NextMove.TASKS exists with no carrier; parallel-handoffs.md tells agents to hand-write a legacy note the runtime refuses).

Command convention: validate (schema-only, offline, the dry-run #609 asks for), schema <name> (JSON Schema from the catalog; wheypoint types are not registered today and the catalog scans only contracts.py globals for the @contract marker), lint keeps store-integrity meaning, handoff replaces handoff-cli with render/parse/dispatch and wheypoint renders its preamble through the shared render_handoff_slug. Rename paths-cli, gates-cli, findings-cli likewise in a separate mechanical PR; blast radius not counted.

Human ergonomics evidence: real projection at ~/.local/share/cheese/paulnsorensen-dotfiles/work/session-analytics-2026-09/projections/2-rev-71875591e106.md shows 6 decisions, 3 open questions, 2 artifact links, 5 context lines in the record and none of them in the note. The note is preamble + pins + 'Gating entries: none' + an empty JSON dossier fence. Gaps in priority order: no body; no list command (7 work items under this repo's store, no way to enumerate); no log/history view over revisions/; dossier rendered as JSON; opaque entry ids without summaries; preamble layout drift between schema_version 1 projections (pins before orientation) and the current renderer (pins after). Projection digest is recomputed on render so layout changes carry no migration cost, and render-html already accepts any Markdown artifact.

SKILL.md is 396 lines, about 3,801 estimated tokens against the repo's 3,600 budget. Prose that the runtime already enforces or that enforces nothing: flow steps 1-26 (collapse to ~8 after S1), status derivation (25 lines), next: semantics (35 lines; move affinage-needs-PR-ref and cook/cut-need-existing-artifact into gates), handwritten legacy notes (30 lines; move to a reference), Document + required-sections (60 lines; orphaned, becomes S7 plus a lint rule keyed on status and next), redaction (add a gate that refuses secret-pattern text). Target about 130 lines with more enforcement.

Outstanding #553 gates by owner: wheypoint (unknown-key, redaction, next/artifact coherence, required-sections lint; grounding is not a wheypoint concern, recommend excluding it from that metric); cook receipt gate (#546, not started); mold explorer-delegation gate (not started; grounding table landed in #585); age tree lock landed in #586 but #552 effect unmeasured; cross-cutting per-gate telemetry and skill-author audit rule not started.

Suggested PR order: (1) S6 + validate + schema, small, closes three issues; (2) S1-S5 as one schema_version bump; (3) S7, S8, projection body, list, log, human rendering; (4) SKILL.md rewrite; (5) -cli rename.

Not checked: callers of commit outside wheypoint; how many skills reference handoff-cli; whether Codex skill variants duplicate the prose; the installed ~/.claude/skills/wheypoint copy is older prose than the repo's skills/wheypoint/SKILL.md.

Runtime finding while writing this checkpoint: checkpoint refused a decision_dossier on a non-gating question ('decision_dossier describes 1 open fork(s) while nothing blocks continuation'). A parked fork's options, evidence, and prior leaning cannot be recorded without gating the whole record. Add to the ergonomics list: allow a dossier on any active question, require it only when gated. Fork content for the derived-status question: (a) questions gate by default, breaks auto-dispatch for every parked question; (b) keep the flag and render open non-gating entries in the projection, breaks nothing, prior leaning (b). Evidence: wheypoint.py:340,353; projection.py:103.
